paragraphs.text: Archangels are higher ranked and often considered the strongest type of angel .
Archangels have appeared on Alara , Dominaria , Innistrad , Kaladesh , Mirrodin , Ravnica , Serra's Realm , and Zendikar . Visions featured a generic card called Archangel from Dominaria.

In Serra's Realm , Radiant was an archangel who oversaw the realm in Serra 's absence. On Alara , Asha is a mythological archangel while Maelstrom Archangels wield the power of all five kinds of mana instead of just one. During the New Phyrexian Invasion , an echo of Serra helped Elspeth Tirel ascend into an archangel planeswalker. On Innistrad , Avacyn and Liesa were both known as archangels. On Zendikar , when most of the plane's memory of the Eldrazi faded over time, a select few greater archangels including Iona were powerful enough to resist their reign and maintain their sight, their loyalty to the downtrodden, and their ability for voluntary action.
